excerpts.text: The men's tournament in [ice hockey at the 2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ice_hockey_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics "Ice hockey at the 2026 Winter Olympics") took place in [Milan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milan "Milan"), Italy, between 11 and 22 February 2026.[[1]](#cite_note-1) Twelve countries [qualified](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ice_hockey_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics_–_Men's_qualification "Ice hockey at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Men's qualification") for the tournament; eight via [ranking](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IIHF_World_Ranking "IIHF World Ranking") by the [IIHF](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Ice_Hockey_Federation "International Ice Hockey Federation"), three via qualification tournaments, and [Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy_men's_national_ice_hockey_team "Italy men's national ice hockey team") as hosts. [Russia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russia_men's_national_ice_hockey_team "Russia men's national ice hockey team") and [Belarus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belarus_men's_national_ice_hockey_team "Belarus men's national ice hockey team") were banned from competing due to the countries' [invasion of Ukraine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russo-Ukrainian_war_(2022–present) "Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)").[[2]](#cite_note-2)[[3]](#cite_note-3)

[Russia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russia_men's_national_ice_hockey_team "Russia men's national ice hockey team") and [Belarus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belarus_men's_national_ice_hockey_team "Belarus men's national ice hockey team") were banned from competing due to the countries' [invasion of Ukraine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russo-Ukrainian_war_(2022–present) "Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)").[[2]](#cite_note-2)[[3]](#cite_note-3)
